accounting: every Muse proposal stays in the denominator (executor invalid_proposals); runs are never retried; REFUSED and INCOMPLETE are final; transport failures count against R
admission: every Track A case classified REPRODUCED or NOT REPRODUCED, logged before its first RA-MD request; REFUSED and CONTROL FAILED cases are reported only

analysis.post_hoc: anything not listed here is labelled POST-HOC
analysis.primary: case-level detection RA-MD vs RA-DET (exact McNemar), schedules to first verified detection (paired Gehan sign test, censored at B), via paired_eval.py
analysis.uncertainty: exact Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals: per-arm detection rate; discordant split
analysis.unit: the historical case; seeds and replicates are never cases
analysis.verdict_rule: paired_eval: INSUFFICIENT SAMPLE below 10 paired defect cases; no claim of significance otherwise unless p < 0.05

arm_definitions: AMENDMENT_003_DRAFT_v2.md §2, unchanged: RA-DET = curated workloads and/or the systematic grid (exactly 3 per case, frozen per case before its first live run); RA-MD = validated Muse workload proposals
arm_order: per case: sha256(case_id) first byte even -> RA-DET then RA-MD; odd -> RA-MD then RA-DET (image builds are outside the timed region in both orders)

arms_not_applicable.RA-DET-C: draft v2 §2: RA-DET's goals with the constructor replaced by literal translation. There is no constructor in these integrations to replace, so the control has nothing to isolate.
arms_not_applicable.RA-MDS: draft v2 §2: Muse proposals plus Muse state goals through the constructor. No state-goal stage (as RA-MS), so it would only relabel RA-MD.
arms_not_applicable.RA-MS: draft v2 §2: RA-DET's drivers with Muse state goals through the deterministic constructor. These integrations have no state-goal stage: all initial state is created by the workload's own public API calls (push, enqueue, cancel) inside the run. A Muse-state arm would only relabel RA-DET.

deviation_cost: the plan's $10 per evaluation is replaced by the sprint's stricter $5 total Meta cap (research_tools/nbc/budget.py), shared with onb-pilot/2
frozen_before: any RA-MD request on any case
label: RA-NONBLIND EXPLORATORY: developer-selected development cases, developer-written oracles; never confirmatory, never pooled with confirmatory results

muse.context: the integration's MUSE_CONTEXT (registry and R1 schema only) and its workload schema
muse.model: muse-spark-1.3 (DEFAULT_MODEL; MODEL_NAME as in .env, recorded per call)

schedule_explorer: coordinated.Policy 'seeded' via each integration's run(); unchanged for both arms
seeds: real_executor.seed_for(case_id, replicate, i): identical for both arms
